candidate.definition_en: To separate into pieces as a result of a blow, shock, or strain.
candidate.explanation_ar: يكسر حاجة ويخليها حتت، أو يخالف وعد أو قانون.

senses.definition_en: To separate into pieces as a result of a blow, shock, or strain.
examples: If you drop that bowl, it will break.

senses.definition_en: To fail to obey a rule, law, or promise.
examples: He promised not to break the law.
If you drop that bowl, it will break.
He promised not to break the law.
candidate.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Brake' 'فرامل' العربية.. لو ضغطت فرامل فجأة ممكن حاجة تتكسر 'Break'.
